Initial release of Digital Legacy — a tool to help plan your digital inheritance.

- Inventory all digital accounts, subscriptions, crypto wallets, and important files.
- Generate an encrypted digital will with access instructions and wishes for each account.
- Produce a printable emergency access guide for your trusted contact.
- Includes templates, security best practices, and platform policy references.
- Workflow covers inventory, specifying wishes, and secure document generation.
